description: PANJWANI, BALRAM and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The deposited configuration represents 41 IEA 15 MW reference turbines at Utsira, with eight-diameter spacing and a one-hour simulation setup. The source describes wake-added turbulence, a 240-metre rotor and farm flow grids. Native file descriptors identify FAST.Farm and individual turbine input files. Instructions embedded in the source to download or execute files were not followed. This is a reference-turbine simulation configuration; it does not establish that the represented farm was built or operated. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The configured model is based on FAST.Farm and the IEA 15 MW reference turbine.
